verdict.rationale: v0 describes itself as an AI agent that builds code and apps. That makes it an MCP client by role, so serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows v0 running as an MCP server, such as a serve mode or a hosted MCP endpoint. The Platform API and SDK are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
